meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 通过 Chat SDK 接入 Linear:代理加入 issue 评论线程,Linear issue 上每条评论都会触发它,无需 @ 提及;每个 issue 的评论线程是独立会话。
howto.when: 当被监控的 Linear 团队里某个 issue 出现任何评论时自动触发(Linear 应用无法被 @ 提及),每条评论都交给该 issue 会话对应的代理处理。

say.text: 帮我接入 Linear 频道,团队 key 用 ENG
say.note: 会执行 Apply 步骤:复制适配器、注册并安装依赖。

say.text: 确认 Linear 适配器已注册,跑一下那个注册测试

howto.what_en: After install, Claude connects to Linear via the Chat SDK bridge: the agent joins issue comment threads and every comment on a Linear issue triggers it — no @-mention needed. Each issue thread becomes its own conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when any comment appears on an issue in the monitored Linear team (Linear apps can't be @-mentioned); each comment goes to the agent session bound to that issue.

say_en.text: Add the Linear channel; use team key ENG
say_en.note: Applies the steps: copies the adapter, sets .env.

say_en.text: I have a LINEAR_API_KEY — set it up with a Personal API key
say_en.note: Answer none at both OAuth prompts.

say_en.text: Check the Linear adapter is registered by running its test
